title: Gojo Limitless vs Sukuna Malevolent Shrine
script: This is Unlimited Void. This is Malevolent Shrine. So what's the difference? Most JJK fans think Gojo and Sukuna's domains work the same way. They don't. Unlimited Void floods the enemy's brain with infinite information to paralyze them. But Malevolent Shrine has no outer barrier, unleashing relentless slashes across a 200m radius. Gojo's domain overwhelms the mind, while Sukuna's domain shreds physical reality. Follow for more.
